major_work.title: 고금리 충격 속 반도체 상대강도는 시장 전체 Risk-On보다 이익 모멘텀 집중/좁은 breadth 신호일 수 있다
confirmed: 2026-09-29 US session: 10Y Treasury yield reached about 5.293% and 30Y about 5.621%; Dow/S&P500/Nasdaq all closed slightly lower.
2026-09-30 09:15 KST: KOSPI was 6,951.27, +1.17%, with the open described as chip-led despite elevated US Treasury yields.
2026-09-29 Korea session already showed a related divergence: foreign selling kept KOSPI weak while Samsung Electronics and other chip stocks rebounded in the morning.
hypothesis: If semiconductor relative strength persists while global duration pressure remains extreme, earnings/export momentum may temporarily dominate discount-rate pressure specifically in chips rather than signal broad Korean risk-on.
A widening gap between cap-weighted KOSPI and equal-weight/breadth would be a warning that headline index strength is increasingly concentrated and fragile.
unknown: 10:02 KST full-market breadth, final close and investor-flow decomposition are not yet known.
Causal share of AI/export earnings versus technical rebound, dividend-related flow, treasury-share demand and overnight semiconductor beta is unknown.
No claim is made about specific large-player inventory, intent or target price.

provenance.fact: KOSPI +1.17% at 09:15; chip gains led open; elevated US yields weighed on sentiment
US 10Y intraday 5.293%, 30Y 5.621%; US major indices slightly lower
Sept 29 morning foreign selling > KRW1tn kept KOSPI lower despite Samsung/chip rebound

small_works.note: Official September trade release remains scheduled for Oct 1; Reuters +62.0% remains forecast, not actual.
No new authoritative evidence in this run sufficient to change prior classification.

handoffs.request: Test days/regimes with US10Y >=5.2%: semiconductor basket vs KOSPI, equal-weight KOSPI and advance/decline breadth; control USDKRW, oil, SOX overnight return, export surprises and dividend/ex-date effects.
Falsify earnings-dominance interpretation using mechanical rebound, dividend arbitrage unwind, treasury-share/corporate buying, index concentration and overnight beta explanations.
